name: Instagram Prompt Creator - Additive v1
description: Original non-explicit Reels direction options. Import with Upload JSON to merge; no defaults or existing IDs are replaced.
usage_notes: Import this file using the existing Upload JSON control. The importer merges groups and options and keeps existing selections.
Every new option ID starts ig-. Every new group ID starts ig-. Existing groups are extended without changing their mode, defaults, or old options.
Select a Reel format and only the relevant action specialty; leave unrelated action groups at None to avoid conflicting instructions.
Use the existing Camera movement, Framing, Lighting, Time & pace, Voice treatment, Soundscape, and Music controls for exclusive choices.
No new option is selected automatically. Importing again does not duplicate options.
Finishing choices are labeled as plans. They do not claim the generation model performs captions, cuts, interpolation, audio mux, or licensed-track reuse.
Use your own scene summary, source links, exact dialogue, product facts, and desired actions. The pack never fetches or inspects references.
The taxonomy is broad rather than exhaustive or a real-time popularity ranking. It contains no promise of reach, engagement, or model execution.
Saved upstream MiniMax guides informed reference roles and sound separation; all option prose is independently authored.
